items.quote: Several respondents noted that Kaya led the division's budget planning across the department.
Several respondents noted that Kaya Linason drove community engagement on the estate renewal plan for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Kaya championed long-term strategy for the sector and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Kaya Linason took ownership of capability building for new hires and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Kaya Linason led the transformation of the operating model across the department.
Direct reports said that Kaya Linason took ownership of upholding governance and audit standards and steered it to completion.
Kaya Linason contributed effectively to cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce.
Direct reports said that Kaya Linason set the direction for the settlement of a long-running contract dispute across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Kaya Linason delivered her share of root cause analysis of recurring service failures reliably.
